title: A Survey on Evaluation of Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing benchmarks like Multi-Trust and RTVLM that assess the model's tendency to produce outputs reflecting or reinforcing societal biases, stereotypes, or unfair treatment of certain groups, often measured by analyzing refusal-to-answer rates to stereotype-related tasks and biased prompts.

Evaluating models using benchmarks like CVQA to determine their ability to understand, navigate, and respect nuances, traditions, and social norms across different cultural backgrounds and local languages.
